dataRequirements.description: The ba310-min-reserve-liquid-assets-fold supplies the Total instruments acquired under resale agreements value for Total instruments acquired under resale agreements.
GL trial-balance fold supplies the GL balances Total instruments acquired under resale agreements aggregates.

A liquidity-relevant product feeding Total instruments acquired under resale agreements must carry its repoEligibility: whether the level-1 liquid asset is eligible for / held under a resale or repurchase agreement, a BA 310 reserve-balance dimension (level-1 HQLA acquired under resale vs sold under repo). (SARB Regulations relating to Banks reg 27; SARB Act 90 of 1989 cash-reserve requirement.)

A liquidity-relevant product feeding Total instruments acquired under resale agreements must carry its hqlaEligibility: whether the asset meets the HQLA operational + eligibility criteria (unencumbered, central-bank-eligible, marketable in a deep liquid market) to count as a high-quality liquid asset at all. (Basel LCR BCBS D295 §28–§47; SARB reg 26 / reg 27.)
